==Notes==
*You actually gain the [[energy]] bonus for ''each'' attacking foe you hit. This applies when you are using a [[scythe]].
* If used against a target that is in the middle of casting a spell while they are under the effect of [[Daze]], or if [[Dwarven Battle Stance]] is in effect, the interrupt will land before Counterattack activates. Making it possible to activate the energy gain effect if the enemy was set to an "attacking" state.
